newsitem.title: USA: Sotheby's names William Sheridan CFO.
newsitem.headline: Sotheby's names William Sheridan CFO.

text.p: Sotheby's Holdings Inc said on Monday that it appointed William Sheridan senior vice president and chief financial officer.

The company said the appointment is effective November 18. Sheridan is a partner in the firm of Deloitte & Touche, where he has been principal account partner on the Sotheby's account for the last three years.
Sotheby's Holdings said Sheridan succeeds Kevin Bousquette, who was recently appointed its chief operating officer.
Sotheby's Holdings is the parent company of Sotheby's world wide auction, art-relatd financing and real estate activities.
